description:
LANDED accb5cfbe on wt/kdt-close (PR #110, draft), 2026-09-03. Cold review with
prototype (approve-with-fixes, folded) + adversarial refutation.

THE CHANGE: callsite_dispatch.rs `covers -> bool` became `seating -> Seating
{ Separated, Covering, Escaping }`: REACHABILITY FIRST (a plan row is a
conjunction over its subjects, so a pair admits a common call iff every
position admits a common value -- RuntimeTypePredicate::overlaps per
position; a length mismatch is separation), COVERAGE SECOND and unchanged.
seats_before = Covering(x,y) && (!Covering(y,x) || strictly_inside);
every_inversion_covers asserts !Escaping (a separated inversion routes
nothing); the drop's stand-in test getting more permissive on a Separated
pair is safe by construction (test_inside means the narrow arm admits
nothing at the disjoint position, so its row is unreachable). The doc names
the three arrival-kept residues and their owners: the inseparable question
group (fz-kdt.107: a value reaches both, order is meaning), overlap-without-
containment (fz-kdt.131: order is representation safety), and the SEPARATED
pair (fz-kdt.194: no value reaches both; a canonical tie-break is safe there
and only there). The census reader mirrors the relation; separated_somewhere,
EscapeClass::UnreachablePair, BLIND_ESCAPE_UNREACHABLE_PAIRS and every
UNREACHABLE-PAIR sentence are gone.

WHAT IT PROVED: at base the fiction MOVED arms, not only counts -- on 00277
w13 seats_before(arm 9, arm 4) was TRUE and the seat reordered a pair no
value can reach (red-first text captured). Gates: the reproducer
(arms_no_value_can_reach_both_of_are_not_a_seat_question) and the soundness
battery (a_separated_pair_of_tests_is_a_disjoint_pair_of_surfaces: 34 types,
1156 ordered pairs, 364 sharing pairs, 0 over-separations, 0 self-blind
tests -- the [] carve-out keeps disjoint-head list tests a seat question).

MEASURED (base 8de517a28): SELECTION_SEAT_ALLOWANCE 73 -> 45 (w13-w19 8 -> 4
each), ARRIVAL_KEPT 76 -> 48, SEED_SIX 78 -> 49 (executable 201 leaves --
one of fz-kdt.131's two seed-6 pairs was fiction; 203 stays), reachable 48
unchanged; corpus interp 0 / run 0 movers; canon exactly 2 movers (00420 +
behavior/enum_take_drop_split: an arm ORDER swap on the call-edge plan cs0
in List.reduce_while_cont/3 whose s2 callable sets are disjoint closure
literals -- the old reading had been PINNING a schedule-free order there by
accident; the truthful rule hands it back to arrival = fz-kdt.194's residue,
measured: canon under arms:3 differs from settled on 23 fixtures at base and
25 at head); stress 40/40 identical on both movers; FIFO/LIFO unchanged (2);
surface-membership census unchanged; lib 1615/0/5; matrix 485/0/9. 179's
reproducer is now 45 reachable seats (34 on 00277).
REFUTER (FIX-THEN-MERGE, folded): the doc sentence "a realizable test overlaps itself" was FALSE -- runtime_type_predicate_tuple_arities drops an arity for any same-arity negation, so {any, any} & not({int, int}) projects to the EMPTY predicate; an untested self-blind position could then separate a stand-in pair and the drop deleted a live arm (two arms at (:ok, that surface) / (:ok | :tail, that surface) went Direct where base kept the narrow arm first). Fixed by `early == late || overlaps` in both readers (one and the same question never separates; a Separated pair now differs at the separating position, which is discriminating by construction), the gate an_untested_position_is_not_a_separation, the battery grown to 65 types (4,225 pairs, 0 unexplained violations). The projection defect is fz-kdt.202. COORDINATOR GATE (fresh, marker COORD-GATE-1788431411, HEAD accb5cfbe): fmt clean; build 0 warnings; clippy -D warnings clean; lib 1616 / 0 / 5; fixture_matrix --test-threads=1 485 / 0 / 9 (known-red set unchanged).

comments.text: MEASURED AND PINNED (fz-kdt.178, 8de517a28). BLIND_ESCAPE_UNREACHABLE_PAIRS holds all 28 on 00277 w13-w19 (4 each): subject 0 asks a :tail head against an int head, which no value answers both ways, while subject 1 is the list behind it that no test reads. The census reader's separated_somewhere uses RuntimeTypePredicate::overlaps and mirrors production's covers exactly, so both readers change together. Two more facts for the fix: (a) under arms:6, enum_predicate_search's `[int | :nil] with [int]` at executable 201 is ALSO an unreachable pair, so one of fz-kdt.131's two seed-6 facet-3 pairs is fiction and only the executable-203 pair is real; (b) the refuter measured 00420_enum_take_drop_split and behavior/enum_take_drop_split at 0 unreachable-pair readings (the first cut's "215" did not exist); they are in the census with 4 reachable seat findings each, so the corpus's 45 reachable seat findings are all pinned. Sequence: before fz-kdt.179.

title: A pair no value can reach is not a seat question: the covering relation asks reachability first, and a separated pair is neither blind nor covering
